intentAndPurpose.intent: PRD-derived loading placeholder primitives. Compose SkeletonItem blocks inside SkeletonGroup for automatic shimmer stagger. No canonical OneUI Figma component is currently published.

props.description: Content used for natural size inference when width/height are omitted.

props.description: Explicit width — when set, sizing ignores children.

codeSnippets.title: Basic Usage
codeSnippets.code:
import { SkeletonGroup, SkeletonItem } from '@oneui/ui';

<SkeletonGroup>
  <SkeletonItem width="100%" height="var(--Spacing-5)" />
  <SkeletonItem width="75%" height="var(--Spacing-5)" />
</SkeletonGroup>
